observed_runtime_behavior: array_shuffle delegates to shuffleArray. shuffleArray uses Math.random directly, so random_set_seed does not determine its permutation.
native_behavior: pc.array_shuffle performs deterministic Fisher-Yates using SourceRandom.Index, clamping the inclusive generator endpoint to the last valid index. Equal seeds repeat the permutation; top-level row contents are preserved.
parity_limit: Desktop runner seed-to-permutation parity is unverified. Native deterministic seed handling deliberately differs from the inspected HTML5 shuffle.
